comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: The main African origin of the citizens of Haiti in the Caribbean is Benin, although most West African states are also represented in the genetic makeup. The language Fon and the religion Voodoo are common to Haiti and Benin. In present day Republic of Benin, the Kingdom of Dahomey existed from 1600 until 1904. The Kingdom of Dahomey in Benin should not be confused with the Kingdom of Benin (1180-1897) in neighboring Nigeria, famous for its marvelous bronze statues. Both however share the Fon language, Voodoo, and honouring of the leopard and the python as sacred animals. It was very moving to see the route of the slaves and the Gate of Departure of the shackled captives, but heartening to see the visit of their descendants from the Caribbean (most probably from Haiti, although the video did not say). The industriousness of the people is commendable. It was fascinating to see the temple of the pythons and the Voodoo night watchmen. Interesting to see the long trumpets for ‘Id Nabi (birthday of prophet Mohammad) in Nikki.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Thank you for sharing these fascinating historical insights and your perspective on the cultural connections between Benin and the Caribbean!
